notes.title: Sprite Forge 1.0.611
notes.content: -Fixed problem with displaying input fields for some faucets

notes.title: Sprite Forge 1.0.61
notes.content: -Added the ability to customize the sprite overlay on top of layers.

notes.title: Sprite forge 1.0.6
notes.content:
Updated the appearance of all floating windows; they can now be moved.
Added a new "Auto" mode for automatic sprite template generation.
Fixed the issue where the pencil flickered over another color.
Added selection and the ability to move the selected sprite area.
Fixed the issue where sprites were not generated after deleting a color. Now, there will always be at least one color in the palette.
Updated the program help link.
Fixed the pencil issue when rapidly sketching.

notes.title: Sprite Forge 1.0.57
notes.content:
The restrictions on opening images have been lifted. Proceed at your own risk. 
The export size setting for tile set has been removed; now it works automatically.

notes.title: Sprite Forge 1.0.56
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=ciq4JZ3Q3j8;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]Added the ability to open files in PNG format. 
Added the ability to load a palette from a PNG image.

notes.title: Sprite Forge 1.0.52
notes.content:
Added the ability to adjust the light size.
Fixed issues with saving.

notes.title: Sprite Forge 1.0.5
notes.content:
Added eraser size adjustment.
Added pencil size adjustment.
Added the ability to change and drag main windows.
Added the ability to draw lines when holding down the shift key.

notes.title: Sprite Forge 1.0.4
notes.content:
Added the ability to save a file to a directory.
Added the ability to open a file from a directory.
You can save the file by pressing Ctrl + S.
Fixed the issue with exporting on macOS and Linux.
Fixed the issue with the lighting of multiple layers.

notes.title: Sprite Forge 1.0.35
notes.content:
►The ability to create a custom palette for generated sprites has been added.
♥Tileset generation has been added; the total number of possible tiles is 48.
►A filling component has been added to simplify the drawing process.
►Sprite lighting has been improved - version 2.
►An issue with selecting the 10th color has been fixed.
►An issue with translation into other languages has been resolved by disabling support for other languages.

notes.title: Sprite Forge 1.0.22
notes.content:
Fixed: issue with undoing action on other layers.
Fixed: Frequent generation leads to incorrect output of the number of sprites.
Fixed: Pixels were drawn incorrectly during generation.
Fixed: problem with zooming while drawing.
